$schema_note: Append-only log of curriculum import runs. One entry per source document processed. Real, hash-verified files supplied by the product owner on 2026-08-21 (SA_CAPS_Grade4-7_Source_Pack.zip) — the first real DBE documents this platform has processed. Every topic these runs created is content_workflow_status=REVIEW_REQUIRED; none is verified or published. records_created counts survive an automatic frequency-based filter that drops repeated running page headers/footers (see curriculum-tools/src/detectors/curriculumDetectors.ts:dropRepeatedRunningText) — it does not mean 213 distinct real topics, several are still assessment-appendix noise a reviewer will reject; see README for the honest breakdown.

errors: This source is a 5-page amendment/circular, not the full Natural Sciences and Technology CAPS document. A large share of the 80 records are assessment-appendix content (a cognitive-levels verb list, a formal-assessment table) mislabelled with the last grade/term section seen before them, not genuine topics — flagged for the reviewer, not silently hidden.

Most records come from an assessment-programme appendix (pages 42-44), not the main term-by-term topic tables — same last-grade/term state-leak issue as the NS&T amendment. Real topic names are mixed in with assessment scaffolding text; reviewer must sort.

Grade 7's content section (pages 21-29) is a dense 3-column table (CONTENT AREA | CONTENT | CLARIFICATION) that the PDF table-detection heuristic did not recognise as tabular — it extracted as flowing paragraph text instead, which the topic detector does not harvest from. Grade 8/9 sections elsewhere in the same document DID get detected as tables (27 Grade-9 candidates found, correctly excluded since this run only requested Grade 7). Needs a smarter table-detection heuristic or manual topic entry for this document.

No grade/term section marker matching any of the currently-implemented patterns was found anywhere in this document (177 topic-like candidates detected, none attributable to a specific grade). This document uses a different internal structure than the other 8 in this pack; not yet diagnosed.

This document presents Grades 7-9 as a single shared table with grade columns ("Grade 7 - 9 | Term 1 | Term 2 | Term 3 | Term 4"), not repeated per-grade section headers. The current detector tracks sequential section markers and cannot read grade-as-column tables; needs a column-aware extractor.

30 Grade-7 candidates were initially detected, but every one was the document's own running title repeated verbatim ('CREATIVE ARTS GRADES 7-9') and was correctly dropped by the running-header filter. No genuine Grade 7 topic content was extracted.

128 candidates detected (115 tagged Grade 9, 13 ungraded), zero tagged Grade 7 — this document's real grade structure is a grid table ("Term | Grade 4 | Grade 5 | Grade 6" / "Term | Grade 7 | Grade 8 | Grade 9"), not sequential section headers; the 115 Grade-9 hits are a coincidental partial match, not genuine section detection, and were excluded from this Grade-7-only run either way.

The 53 candidates the generic per-row/column fallback detector found on this document's other pages (raw arithmetic-example fragments, not topic names) were excluded from this import rather than written as noise. Only the 47 structural content-outline-table candidates were kept.
